name: model-escalator
description: Run cheap models in parallel and escalate only when they get stuck: nudge, senior consult, hot model swap. Measures savings and learns the right model per task.

thresholdHaiku.title: Haiku difficulty threshold
thresholdHaiku.description: Difficulty score at which an agent that started on Haiku gets the next intervention.

thresholdSonnet.title: Sonnet difficulty threshold
thresholdSonnet.description: Difficulty score at which an agent that started on Sonnet gets the next intervention.

thresholdOpus.title: Opus difficulty threshold
thresholdOpus.description: Difficulty score at which an agent that started on Opus gets the next intervention.

graceSteps.title: Grace steps
graceSteps.description: Steps to wait after an intervention before the next one.

oscillationEdits.title: Edits before oscillation
oscillationEdits.description: Edits of the same file without progress tolerated before each further edit raises the difficulty score.

stallMinutes.title: Stall window (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Minutes without any event after which a running agent is reported as stalled and gets the next ladder note on its next tool call. A tool call still running counts as activity until three times this long.

verifyCommand.title: Verification command
verifyCommand.description: Optional check run at the end of each tracked agent's run (split on spaces, quotes group, no shell). A non-zero exit counts as a failed run for learning; a command that cannot start or times out is ignored. Empty turns it off.

verifyTimeoutSeconds.title: Verification timeout (seconds)
verifyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the verification command may run before it is abandoned and ignored (at most 600).

seniorModel.title: Senior model
seniorModel.description: Model asked for advice at the consult level (alias or full id).

levels.title: Enabled levels
levels.description: Comma-separated escalation levels, from: nudge, consult, swap, human. Disabled levels are skipped.

maxTier.title: Highest swap tier
maxTier.description: Highest model tier an agent may be swapped up to: haiku, sonnet or opus. Agents already at this tier skip the swap level. Never above opus.

prudentTokenRatio.title: Prudent token ratio
prudentTokenRatio.description: Share of the tokens a stronger baseline model is assumed to need, used for the prudent savings estimate (0 to 1).

prices.title: Price overrides
prices.description: Optional JSON overriding USD per million token rates, e.g. {"sonnet":{"input":3,"output":15}}. Rates: input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h.

modelIds.title: Model ids
modelIds.description: Optional JSON with the full model id to send on a swap, per tier, e.g. {"sonnet":"us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-...","opus":"..."}. Needed on Bedrock, Vertex or a gateway when swaps report a model not available. Beats ids seen in the session and the defaults.

maxConsultsPerAgent.title: Consults per agent
maxConsultsPerAgent.description: Senior consults one agent may get. A refused call and its retry count as one consult. Once reached, the ladder skips the consult level and ask_for_help answers that no further consult is available. 0 allows none.

maxConsultsPerSession.title: Consults per session
maxConsultsPerSession.description: Senior consults across all agents of the session, with the same counting. 0 allows none.

pauseAtHuman.title: Pause at the human level
pauseAtHuman.description: When an agent reaches the human level, refuse all its further tool calls until you resume it with /escalator resume <id> (or all). Off keeps the note only.

deescalateAfter.title: Return to a cheaper model after progress
deescalateAfter.description: Progress signals (failing tests dropping or reaching 0) after which an agent that was swapped up goes back one tier, once per run. Off by default: returning to a cheaper model rewrites the prompt cache and may bring the block back. 0 is off.

effortStep.title: Raise the effort before a model swap
effortStep.description: Adds a level between the senior consult and the model swap: the stuck agent keeps its model and its requests carry a higher effort (one step above their own, at least the effort boost) until its next swap. Skipped for a model that takes no effort or a request already at max. Off by default until measured: a higher effort costs more output tokens and a change of effort rewrites the prompt cache.

notifyLead.title: Tell the lead about escalations
notifyLead.description: Add a short notice to the main conversation, read by the lead, whenever an agent is swapped to a stronger model, cannot be (the model is not available) or needs a human. At most 10 messages per session; active mode only. Off keeps the log and the toasts only.

effortBoost.title: Effort boost
effortBoost.description: Lowest effort the effort level raises a request to: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. The request always goes at least one step above its own effort.

consultBudgetUsd.title: Consult budget (USD)
consultBudgetUsd.description: Dollars the senior calls may cost in the session, retried calls included. Once reached, no further consult. 0 means no dollar limit.
